integrity: The mathematical proof is analytic. Finite numerical tests independently check formulas but are not substituted for infinite-dimensional or continuous-parameter proofs. The general renewal formula and high-rate principles are credited to prior work. Originality and priority remain qualified by incomplete primary-source access.
scientific_limitations: Perfect absorption on one finite Brownian circle, independent Poisson clocks and independent interior Beta(alpha+1,alpha+1) reset draws with alpha>-1. The finite-rate existence and singular optimizer statements are for 1<alpha<(sqrt(57)-3)/4 and alpha downarrow 1. Minimizer uniqueness and behavior at larger alpha are not resolved. The 2026 motivating article was accessible only through its abstract.
title: Endpoint depletion creates a singular optimal restart frequency in circular Brownian search
